introHtml: Seventh Avenue Apothecary containers bring a vintage pharmacy look to your dispensary, with amber glass jars and metal screw-top lids that protect contents from light. These containers work well for labeling with screen-printed or foil-stamped logos, giving your brand a premium, apothecary-style presentation. Bulk orders suit dispensaries, boutique retailers, or event giveaways where product visibility and shelf appeal matter.
